target_customer: Filipino small and medium businesses and startups buying HMO health plans for employees
problem: Few Filipinos have comprehensive coverage beyond PhilHealth and most health costs are paid out of pocket; SMEs found HMO plans slow and paper based.
business_model: insurance premiums for HMO plans sold to SMEs, delivered through a digital platform and a licensed HMO

founders.name: Camille Ang
founders.background_notes: YC page and Philstar name her as CEO and give no background. Press snippets mention Harvard and Stanford degrees but I did not open a source stating that, so it is left null.

founders.name: Jiawen Tang
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in BusinessWorld and e27 photo captions seen in search results; the YC page lists only Camille Ang.

technical_complexity.rationale: A digital front end for selling and administering HMO plans is standard software; the hard parts were licensing and provider networks, which the company later solved by buying an existing HMO.

defensibility.rationale: Owning a licensed HMO and a decades old provider network, obtained through the 2023 purchase of Health Plan Philippines, is harder to copy than the software alone.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent reaction found. Maxicare is named only by a low authority aggregator and is unverified.

market_need_then: Company statements in press say under 10 percent of Filipinos have comprehensive coverage outside PhilHealth and over half of health costs are out of pocket, which suggests unmet SME demand; these are company claims from search summaries.

branding.domain_note: Uses ourhivehealth.com rather than an exact match domain; no history found.

brand_strength.rationale: Press covers the company and founders but nothing was found on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Hive Health is active. After YC in Summer 2021 it acquired the licensed HMO Health Plan Philippines in November 2023, which gave it an insurance licence and provider network, then raised 6.5 million dollars in July 2024. The path suggests the digital layer alone was not enough and licensing became the strategy; later outcomes are not yet known.
notes: Round of 6.5 million in July 2024 appears in Philstar (opened) and in search result summaries from several outlets (Kr-Asia, e27, Inquirer, Daily Guardian) which call it pre-Series A; stage recorded as other because the opened source does not state it. HPPI acquisition announced November 2023 per search snippets, amount not found. Company site fetch was blocked by a rate limited safety check; e27, Rappler, BusinessWorld and Inquirer fetches failed (rate limit or 403), not worked around. Competitor list empty: no source dated near 2021 found. Batch listed as Summer 2021 by YC; one aggregator says W21.
